categories.name: COATED OVERLAY SHEETS FOR PVC ID CARD
categories.description: Coated Overlay Sheets for PVC ID Cards – Supplied by The Print Planet, Bengaluru & Pan-India. Premium-quality coated overlay sheets designed to provide superior protection, durability, and a professional finish to PVC cards. Manufactured using high-grade materials for excellent transparency, strong fusion bonding, and enhanced resistance to scratches, moisture, and daily wear. Ideal for employee ID cards, student cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, RFID cards, and smart card manufacturing. Suitable for digital, inkjet, and offset PVC card production.

categories.name: ID CARD HOLDER
categories.description:
The Print Planet, in joint venture with The Print Planet Manufacturing Unit, is a trusted manufacturer and supplier of premium quality PVC ID Card Holders in India.

We manufacture durable, professional and high-quality ID card holders suitable for schools, colleges, corporates, events, hospitals, government offices, ID card printers, resellers and B2B dealers.

Our product range includes Crystal Clear Transparent ID Card Holders, Semi-Transparent ID Card Holders, Vertical ID Card Holders, Horizontal ID Card Holders, Two Side Lock Holders and Four Side Lock Holders.

With strong manufacturing support from The Print Planet Manufacturing Unit, we focus on consistent quality, bulk production, attractive finishing and reliable supply for customers across India.

categories.name: PVC CORE SHEETS FOR ID CARD PRINTING
categories.description: PVC Core Sheets for ID Card Printing – Supplied by The Print Planet, Bengaluru & Pan-India. Manufactured from high-quality PVC resin material, these core sheets provide excellent printability, dimensional stability, and strong fusion performance for PVC card production. Designed for inkjet, digital, and offset printing applications, ensuring sharp image quality, vibrant colors, and durable finished cards. Ideal for employee ID cards, student cards, membership cards, loyalty cards, RFID cards, and smart card manufacturing. Suitable for professional and bulk production requirements.
